description.value: Wo's Chinese Restaurant (金穗園美食) is a full-service Chinese restaurant on Main Street in Vancouver's Marpole neighbourhood, serving Cantonese, Szechuan, Beijing, Shanghai, and Hunan cuisine. The restaurant accommodates dine-in, pickup, delivery, catering, and tourist group meals, making it a flexible option for cycling groups or solo riders refuelling on a long ride through South Vancouver. The OSM check_date of May 2025 confirms it remains actively operating.
